data.one_liner: A widget that folds/unfolds a cell with front and inner content
data.what_it_does: The SimpleFoldingCell widget lets you display a front widget that can be tapped to reveal an inner widget with a folding animation. It exposes callbacks for open/close and allows programmatic control via a GlobalKey.
use_when: You need a card-like UI that expands/collapses with a folding effect
You want a lightweight, customizable folding cell without external dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex animation sequences beyond a simple fold
You need a fully featured accordion or expandable list with many items
strengths: Customizable size, padding, duration, and border radius
Provides open/close callbacks and programmatic toggle
weaknesses: Limited to a single cell, not a list widget
Animation options are basic (only duration and curve)
No support for nested folding cells or complex state management
